theorem cntSq_approx {P : ℕ} (hP : Squarefree P) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hb2 : b ≤ 2 * a) :
    |cntSq P a b - (b - a) * (6 / Real.pi ^ 2 * (P / σ 1 P))| ≤
      ∑ e ∈ P.divisors, fsq (Real.sqrt (b / e)) :=

note: Only the v = 2 case is formalized, with the l-sum's lower limit read as max(...) (the printed min makes the lemma false); the general-v 5.08 bound is absent and unused. Erratum: (5.9) and (5.12) print the lower limit min((z/y)/min(r1,r2), z/(2r1r2)), which makes the lemma false (v=2, y=3/2, z=10^6: left side 202646 against main term 135094.9 with error 9274.5); the intended limit is max(...), the range of (5.8), which gives 135091. (checked by `scripts/checks/lemma_5_1_1.py`).
